metaDescription: Bull Terrier vaccine schedule with core ages in weeks. Set reminders so Bull Terrier boosters are not missed.

bodySections.heading: Why timing matters for this schedule
paragraphs: Plan Bull Terrier social milestones around the schedule rows, not the other way around, because the 16-week finish is the usual green light clinics cite for broader Bull Terrier exposure.
Weight range 45-70 lb (20-32 kg) and grooming needs (Short coat; sunburn on white dogs.) belong in the same Bull Terrier household ops list as vaccine dates when busy weeks collide.
If your Bull Terrier is also monitored for kidney disease risk, ask whether bloodwork or orthopedic checks can share a visit with a booster to cut missed Bull Terrier appointments.
After the Bull Terrier puppy/kitten series, keep adult DA2PP / DHPP and rabies renewals on 7/3/1-day reminders so year-two surprises disappear.

bodySections.heading: If a dose is missed or delayed
paragraphs: If your Bull Terrier misses the dose scheduled near week 12, call the clinic the same day with product names — do not restart the Bull Terrier series from memory.
The danger for a delayed Bull Terrier is the gap, not the embarrassment, because parvovirus pressure stays real for an under-vaccinated puppy even in clean-looking neighborhoods.
While waiting for the make-up DA2PP / DHPP visit, skip high-traffic dog parks / unknown-cat intros and keep the Bull Terrier away from unvaccinated animals.
After catch-up, rewrite reminders for the next Bull Terrier due date (7, 3, and 1 day prior) so the same miss does not recur.

faqs.question: When does the Bull Terrier core vaccine series usually finish?
faqs.answer: This breed record completes core vaccines around 16 weeks of age, with rabies timed per local law. Your clinic may adjust intervals for the individual puppy.

faqs.question: What should I do if my Bull Terrier misses a booster?
faqs.answer: Contact your veterinarian for a catch-up plan instead of restarting or skipping ahead. Keep prior dates handy and limit high-risk exposure until the series is current again.

faqs.question: Where can I read Bull Terrier health context beyond vaccines?
faqs.answer: See the Bull Terrier adult health guide for breed predispositions such as deafness risk (especially white), then bring those notes to wellness and vaccine visits.
